description: This file defines the ProjectAPI class, which provides CRUD operations and API endpoints for managing project entities within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It handles project listing, creation, updating, retrieval, and deletion, including validation and access control logic.

classes.name: ProjectAPI
classes.description: API class handling CRUD operations for project entities, including listing, creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion within the Time plugin of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines which project model class to use based on the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles the API endpoint to list all projects with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' method query parameters.

methods.name: getModelParamRule
methods.description: Provides validation rule for the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creating a new project from request body parameters.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Initializes or updates a Project entity with request body data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a project.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules applicable for project creation and update, including uniqueness and length constraints.

methods.name: getProjectCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates an option object for checking unique project names within a customer context.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of projects, ensuring no time logs are associated with the projects.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting projects.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for a single project by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single project.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing project with new data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a project.
